description: This file defines an abstract class ShortcutAdapter for managing and displaying a list of app shortcuts in an Android application. It handles binding shortcut data to views, handling click actions for launching shortcuts and additional actions, and caching app labels.

classes.name: ShortcutAdapter
classes.description: An abstract adapter class used to display and manage app shortcuts in a list view, supporting actions like launch and custom secondary actions.

methods.name: setShortcuts
methods.description: Sets the list of ShortcutInfo objects to be displayed by the adapter.

methods.name: getShortcuts
methods.description: Returns the current list of ShortcutInfo objects managed by the adapter.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of shortcuts.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the ShortcutInfo object at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a stable ID for the item at the specified position.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates whether item IDs are stable across changes.

methods.name: areAllItemsEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether all items are enabled.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the item at the specified position is enabled.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a view for displaying a shortcut at a specific position.

methods.name: bindView
methods.description: Binds shortcut data to the provided view, setting labels, icons, and click listeners.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events for launch and secondary action buttons within a shortcut view.
